reels.caption:
My wardrobe 🤍 Lighting is everything in a walk in wardrobe. You can have the most beautiful set up with beautiful clothes, bags & shoes, but if they are not lit up the right way then the impact of seeing them all displayed will never be quite what it could be. You can see how much the down lighting elevates the room/ clothing display when I turn them on. My tip for a walk in wardrobe would be to light up every individual unit. I used LED strip lighting here.

reels.caption:
Besides the kitchen, the living room is one of the most lived in spaces in your home. It should feel intentional. Yes, you can absolutely have a picture perfect space and still have it be comfortable to actually live in.

Play around with shapes and proportions so the room feels inviting and a little more unique, just like you are. A living room should not feel like a furniture showroom where no one is allowed to sit.

And please, stop copy and pasting what you see online and hoping it magically works in your space. Your living room deserves more effort than a Pinterest screenshot.
